page.layout: One printed title page, single block: title lines centred at top, an engraving (oval woodcut with a motto) in the centre, imprint lines below. Library stamp at lower right and a handwritten number at top right are not transcribed. Faint show-through of text from the reverse is visible in the margins and is not transcribed.
page.notes: The oval engraving shows a wolf and sheep scene with the motto "CHRISTVS PACIFICATOR NOSTER ESAIAE" along its lower edge; the motto is part of the picture and is not transcribed as text. The "Tig." after VVASERI is followed by a period and a comma as printed. The Greek word is printed as EVΦHMOΣ in capitals. Handwritten marks (number 8 at top right, pencil notes at top left and lower left) and the Stadtbibliothek Zürich stamp are not transcribed.
